note: Curated OSRS ironman progression milestones. Requirements use exact hiscore skill names. `req.skills` are level thresholds evaluated against live hiscores; `req.note` describes non-skill gating (quests, prerequisites) shown to the player but not auto-evaluated.

items.name: Graceful outfit

req.note: Buy piece-by-piece with Marks of Grace from rooftop courses.

items.why: −20% run-energy drain; you'll wear it for thousands of hours.

items.name: Protect prayers (43 Prayer)

req.note: Bury/offer bones; build a gilded altar later.

items.why: Protect-from-Melee/Missiles/Magic makes almost all PvM survivable.

items.name: Barrows gloves
items.why: Best-in-slot gloves for most of the game — a huge early spike.

items.name: Fire cape
items.why: Best melee cape until infernal; a rite of passage.

items.name: Ardougne cloak (diary)
items.why: Free unlimited Monastery teleports and useful perks.

items.name: Rune pouch
items.why: Carry three rune types — enables alching, teleports and combat spells anywhere.

items.name: Rune scimitar
items.why: Cheap, fast, self-obtainable — your first real weapon.

items.name: Dragon scimitar
items.why: Best DPS scimitar for ages; carries you through mid-game.

items.name: Dragon defender
items.why: Best-in-slot offhand for melee until Avernic.

items.name: Fighter torso
items.why: Best-in-slot Strength body until Bandos — grab it early.

items.name: Helm of neitiznot
items.why: Great all-round helm with prayer bonus.

items.name: Abyssal whip
items.why: The iconic mid-game weapon; fast and accurate.

items.name: Bandos armour
items.why: Best-in-slot Strength body and legs for years.

items.name: Rune crossbow
items.why: With broad/ruby/diamond bolts it clears the mid-game and early bosses.

items.name: Black d'hide body
items.why: Cheap, self-craftable ranged body with solid defence.

items.name: Ava's assembler
items.why: Best ranged cape: ammo recovery + damage bonus.

items.name: Toxic blowpipe

req.note: Zulrah drop; needs 78 Fishing to fully charge scales.

items.why: Absurd DPS — the single biggest ranged power spike in the game.

items.name: Dragon hunter crossbow
items.why: Best-in-slot vs dragons — melts Vorkath and more.

items.name: Masori armour
items.why: Best-in-slot light ranged armour endgame.

items.name: Mystic robes
items.why: First real mage set; cheap and self-obtainable.

items.name: Imbued god cape
items.why: Best-in-slot magic cape.

items.name: Trident of the seas
items.why: Reliable, self-charging magic weapon for slayer and bossing.

items.name: Occult necklace
items.why: Best-in-slot magic-damage amulet.

items.name: Ancient Magicks + staff
items.why: Ice Barrage freezes for safe-spotting and Barrows/CoX.

items.name: Tumeken's shadow
items.why: The best magic weapon in the game — endgame chase item.

items.name: Slayer helmet

req.note: Black mask + full slayer helm parts.

items.why: Best-in-slot slayer helm; +damage vs task and great stats.

items.name: Abyssal demons (whip)
items.why: Unlocks whip + abyssal dagger drops.

items.name: Smoke devils (occult)
items.why: Occult necklace source.

items.name: Kraken (trident)
items.why: Trident of the seas + tentacle whip upgrade.

items.name: Cerberus (boots)
items.why: Primordial/Pegasian/Eternal crystals → best-in-slot boots.

items.name: Alchemical Hydra
items.why: Brimstone ring + hydra leather; a major slayer money/upgrade sink.

items.name: Zulrah
items.why: Blowpipe, trident and huge GP/uniques — a self-sufficiency engine.

items.name: Vorkath

req.note: Dragon Slayer II. Dragonbane weapon strongly wanted.

items.why: Reliable big money and dragon items; superior slayer target.

items.name: God Wars Dungeon
items.why: Bandos, Armadyl and more best-in-slot gear.

items.name: Chambers of Xeric

req.note: Team or solo; big stat wall.

items.why: Twisted bow, DHCB, Kodai and prayer scrolls.

items.name: Tombs of Amascut
items.why: Masori, shadow, fang and lightbearer — extremely iron-friendly.

items.name: The Inferno (infernal cape)
items.why: Best-in-slot melee cape and bragging rights.

tracks.name: Skilling & Supplies
tracks.blurb: The engine that feeds your PvM.

items.name: Super combat potions (Herb)
items.why: Self-made super combats are a must for serious PvM.

items.name: Prayer potions (Herb 38+)
items.why: Prayer potions gate almost all bossing longevity.

items.name: Herb farming runs
items.why: Your renewable herb supply — the backbone of Herblore.

items.name: Gilded altar (Con 75)
items.why: Fast Prayer XP and a rejuvenation pool at home.

items.name: Shark supply (Cooking/Fishing)
items.why: Renewable high-heal food for hard PvM.

items.name: Blood rune crafting
items.why: Self-sufficient blood runes power trident/ancients/blood spells.

items.name: Piety (70 Prayer)
items.why: +strength/attack prayer — a flat DPS boost everywhere.
